reasoning_content:
Weird: the port for the directly-run server isn't listening, and the nx serve process isn't showing up in ps either. Yet the logs show that the build completed. Did the directly-run process also die?! Same pattern: build completed → process terminated. Let me look at the tail of the app/cms direct logs, and check what's happening.

Wait — in the earlier boards direct run, it was still alive after 600 seconds (wait timed out). So boards stayed alive. Now app and cms are gone? Let me look at the logs.
